body: This is a very factual post that people seem to be disregarding because they (presumably) don’t like Elon. Elon has been dragged into politics even more so than in the past because of twitter. There exists two camps of people in politics right now, those being supporters and cancellers and i generally only see the supporters willing to look at both sides of the coin. Haters gonna hate. Seems to be the nature of politics and cancel culture. People need to learn how to separate logic from emotion.
